patterns.name: Renamed API Parameters
patterns.description: AI renames request parameters in the route handler schema but callers in other files still send the old parameter names, causing validation failures at runtime.

testPattern.description: Verify caller does not send old parameter names

patterns.name: Changed Response Shape
patterns.description: AI restructures the API response object (e.g., wraps data in a nested key) but callers destructure the old shape, causing TypeError at runtime when accessing missing properties.

testPattern.description: Verify caller handles new response shape

patterns.name: New Required Field Not Sent by Callers
patterns.description: AI adds a new required field to the API schema but callers in the blast radius do not send this field, causing schema validation errors (e.g., Zod parse failure) on every call.

testPattern.description: Verify caller sends newly required field

patterns.name: Removed Field Still Sent by Callers
patterns.description: AI removes a field from the API schema (strict validation mode) but callers still send it, causing validation failures or silent data loss depending on schema strictness.

testPattern.description: Verify caller no longer sends removed field

patterns.name: HTTP Status Code Changed
patterns.description: AI changes the HTTP status code returned by an endpoint (e.g., 201→200) but callers check the old status code to determine success, causing silent logic failures.

testPattern.description: Verify caller handles updated status code

patterns.name: Idempotency Key Not Sent by Callers
patterns.description: AI adds an idempotency key requirement to a payment or mutation endpoint schema but callers that trigger the endpoint do not generate or send the idempotency key, causing duplicate operations.

patterns.name: Auth Check Without Ownership Verification
patterns.description: AI adds authentication check (user is logged in) to a new endpoint but omits ownership check (user owns the resource), enabling any authenticated user to access any other user's data (IDOR vulnerability).

testPattern.description: Verify ownership check is performed after auth check

patterns.name: New Endpoint Added Outside Auth Middleware
patterns.description: AI adds a new route or endpoint file outside the authenticated router group, bypassing all authentication middleware. The endpoint is publicly accessible when it should be protected.

testPattern.description: Verify auth middleware is applied to new endpoint

patterns.name: Sanitization at HTTP Boundary Bypassed by Internal Callers
patterns.description: AI adds input sanitization at the HTTP handler level but internal callers (background jobs, service methods) call the underlying service function directly, bypassing sanitization entirely.

testPattern.description: Verify all callers pass through sanitization layer

patterns.name: Multi-Step Operation Without Database Transaction
patterns.description: AI implements a multi-step write operation (debit + credit, create + update) as sequential database calls without wrapping in a transaction. Partial failures leave the database in an inconsistent state.

testPattern.description: Verify atomic operation is wrapped in transaction

patterns.name: Delete/Update Without Cascading to Related Entities
patterns.description: AI implements a delete or update operation on a parent entity but does not cascade the operation to related child entities, leaving orphaned records or inconsistent state.

testPattern.description: Verify cascade delete/update calls are made to related entities

patterns.name: Event Emission Dropped During Refactor
patterns.description: AI refactors an event-emitting handler and silently drops the event emission call. Downstream listeners and notification handlers never fire, breaking async workflows.

testPattern.description: Verify event is emitted after state change

patterns.name: Write Handler Loses Cache Invalidation
patterns.description: AI rewrites a write handler and loses the cache invalidation call. Subsequent reads return stale cached data until TTL expires, causing data consistency issues.

testPattern.description: Verify cache is invalidated after write

patterns.name: ORM Schema Updated Without Migration File
patterns.description: AI updates the ORM schema model (Prisma, SQLAlchemy, Drizzle) to add fields or change column types but does not create the corresponding migration file. The database schema lags behind the code.

testPattern.description: Verify migration file exists for schema change

patterns.name: Return Type Widened to Include Null
patterns.description: AI changes a function return type from T to T|null (or adds undefined) but callers access properties on the return value without null checks, causing runtime TypeError on the null path.

testPattern.description: Verify caller handles null return case

patterns.name: Error Handler Swallows Exceptions Silently
patterns.description: AI wraps a critical operation in a try/catch that swallows all errors without re-throwing or logging. Failures become invisible: callers' catch blocks never fire, monitoring sees no errors.
